event: Check for any test driving counts to saturation (0xFFFFFFFF).

I submitted the verdict as verified: all five items stand as untested. No test drives any of these interrupt event counters to its maximum value and checks that it holds there.

I searched the repository for saturation and overflow terms and for the counters' register names. The only relevant hits were these two:
- **`mcu_intr_handler.c`:** it triggers each interrupt once and counts it, so it never gets near saturation.
- **`libs/mci/mci.c`:** it lists the counters in a register reset and access table, with no saturation stimulus.

I searched each of the five counters by name as well, and every one came back with only its `mci.c` table entry.

The verifier first rejected my submission because I had recorded too few searches. I resubmitted with one search per item, and that was accepted.
